card.plain: The river tugs the opponent one step closer when the move hits.

notes: 'One step' distance is not defined in the GDD; value 1 = one step, unit distance is an open question for the designer. Data only, no new animation (A10); visual is a preset reference for clip-matcher. Number from the rules.md modifiers table.
